The '''Starfighters' Demo Holo''' was an educational [[holodocumentary]] employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Section 243.6998 covered evasive tactics, while section 344.0082 covered other topics such as the disavantages of flying in a straight line.
